svg.text: top down, north up. A grid of memory, as a spreadsheet; guard pages wall off the straight way. Roofs show their height
slow DRAM: streets 100, jumps up to 140
fast: streets 300, jumps up to 140 (longer: to come)
drop: step off, up to 120 down
long drop: a stagger, calls the drone
vault ending in a long drop
guard page: too tall to stand on, a wall
sealed: higher than all round, out of reach
hub: a way out, and a lift up
data bus: the bridge between banks
open from the start: the first way out
CD block: the addresses read, a hidden way in
Backup RAM: a ghost save to draw the drone off its door
SCSP: a voice, to answer the hum
VDP1: a line drawn becomes a bridge
VDP2: a longer vault, over a freed block
Check: the shortest way to each
CD block -1400: reached, 28 towers walked (6 straight)
Backup RAM -450: reached, 9 towers walked (9 straight)
Video output -2400: with its skill, 38 towers walked (15 straight)
Moves: 4 bridge, 85 drop, 1 gated, 6 lift, 7 long, 7 longvault, 55 vault
scale: a tower 1000 x 500 units (2 grid cells a side); the arena is 16000 across
